description: MainActivity.kt defines the main activity for an Android application, managing UI setup, user interactions, calculator input handling, history panel functionality, and theme toggling.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: Main activity class handling UI, calculator logic, history panel, and theme toggling.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes UI components, sets up listeners, and prepares the activity.

methods.name: updateResultBox
methods.description: Updates the expression display box with the current expression.

methods.name: evaluateAndShowResult
methods.description: Evaluates the current expression and updates the result display, adding to history if successful.

methods.name: wireCalculatorKeypad
methods.description: Sets up keypad button click listeners to input symbols and evaluate expressions.

methods.name: setupHistoryPanel
methods.description: Sets up the UI and click handlers for showing and hiding the calculation history drawer.

methods.name: showHistoryDrawer
methods.description: Inflates and displays the history drawer with animated entrance.

methods.name: hideHistoryDrawer
methods.description: Hides and removes the history drawer with animated exit.

methods.name: populateHistoryDrawer
methods.description: Fills the history drawer with stored calculation entries and configures clear/close buttons.

methods.name: updateHistoryPanelIfVisible
methods.description: Refreshes the history display if the history drawer is currently visible.

methods.name: onCreateOptionsMenu
methods.description: Inflates the options menu for theme toggling.

methods.name: onOptionsItemSelected
methods.description: Handles theme toggle menu item selection.

methods.name: toggleTheme
methods.description: Switches between day/night themes and recreates activity to apply changes.

methods.name: onActivityResult
methods.description: Handles activity result, delegating speech recognition results to VoiceSearchBar.

methods.name: onRequestPermissionsResult
methods.description: Handles permission request results, delegating to VoiceSearchBar.
